tags.name: Niche Supper Club Lounge
tags.wheelchair:description: Accessible entrance through the maritime centre - only open during business hours, other entrance has multiple stairs. No accessible washroom. Main dining area up one stair. #dalOT #studentproject #jennaandnicole

tags.name: Residence Inn Halifax Downtown
tags.wheelchair:description: Large bathroom with at least 150 x 150 cm of space with holding grab rails and an accessible hand basin. Entrance had automatic doors for wheelchair accessibility. #DalOT #StudentProject #OliviaandJill

tags.name: The Loose Cannon
tags.wheelchair:description: -2 steps at entrance -Washroom up 3 steps -Small washroom with narrow doorways #DalOT #StudentProject

tags.name: Taipan Express
tags.wheelchair:description: 3 steep steps up to doorway, another step up to level of washrooms, not accessible #DalOT #StudentProject

tags.name: World Tea House
tags.wheelchair:description: - Large washroom with hand rails #DalOT #StudentProject

tags.name: Bluenose II
tags.wheelchair:description: The entrance had 3 steps that were each 9cm in height. The toilet was not wheelchair accessible as the inner doorway width was 59cm and the clear space was only 140cmX59cm.

tags.name: Courtyard Halifax Downtown
tags.wheelchair:description: The entrance had automatic sliding doors and no steps. The clear space of the bathroom measured 155cmX263cm and the inner doorway width measured 90cm. Bathroom has sign on door advertising that it was wheelchair accessible.

tags.name: Cut Contemporary Steak House & Urban Grill
Tim Hortons
tags.wheelchair:description: *Doors at main entranceway have button activation. *Family bathroom not technically wheelchair accessible (inner width is 88cm) individuals in wheelchairs may still be able to use; male/female washrooms are not at all wheelchair accessible

tags.name: TD
tags.wheelchair:description: Short ramp to get inside with automatic door opener. Wide area and height of ATM machines accessible.

tags.name: MEC Mountain Equipment Company
tags.wheelchair:description: MEC has a wheelchair accessible entrance and access to all rooms and floors. There is an elevator available and a wheelchair accessible bathroom. #DalOT #StudentProject

tags.name: Waterfront Warehouse
tags.wheelchair:description: Lower Water street entrance has no automatic doors. Once inside, foyer is cluttered making maneuvering in a wheelchair challenging. Washroom is listed as accessible but door is quite heavy. #DalOT #Studentproject

tags.name: Halifax Town Clock

tags.name: Boston Pizza
tags.wheelchair:description: The wheelchair lift is located at a separate entrance. This entrance was partially accessible due to there being a small step (3cm in height) on the ground. The inner doorway width of the bathroom stall was 92cm and the clear space was 153cmX150cm.

tags.name: The Barrington Hotel
tags.wheelchair:description: #DalOT #StudentProject

tags.name: Halifax Alehouse
tags.source: HRM open Data Halifax Regional Municipality
tags.wheelchair:description: No stairs to get into the building, but to get into eating area and bathrooms there are two steps #DalOT

tags.name: Gio
tags.wheelchair:description: Gio is accessible through the Prince George Hotel, not through street entrance. Washroom is also accessible on main floor of hotel next to lobby, outside of restaurant. #DalOT #studentproject

tags.name: Five Fishermen
tags.wheelchair:description: There is a single step up to get into the building, though the double doors are wide enough to accommodate. Inside, only the grill menu is accessible, as the restaurant is up a steep flight of stairs. The bathroom is several steps down.

tags.name: Canada Post Halifax Station Central
tags.wheelchair:description: Very accessible! Handrails and ramps and automatic doors. #DalOT

tags.name: The Old Triangle Irish Pub
tags.wheelchair:description: There is a side entrance that is wheelchair accessible. There is only one area that is accessible for those with wheelchairs that includes a wheelchair accessible bathroom. #DalOT #StudentProject

tags.name: Flora James shop
tags.source: HRM open Data Halifax Regional Municipality

tags.name: Burrito Jax
tags.wheelchair:description: Step into building was higher than 7cm, but accessible once inside. Bathroom spacious. #DalOT #StudentProject

tags.name: EDNA
tags.source: HRM open Data Halifax Regional Municipality
tags.wheelchair:description: Large group table and bar innaccessible (stool height), many smaller tables at accessible height that can be moved. #DalOT #studentproject

tags.name: Jane's Next Door
tags.source: HRM open Data Halifax Regional Municipality
tags.wheelchair:description: Entrance has accessible ramp but it is quite high grade; counter for mixing coffee is decently elevated; there is no washroom available for customer use, very small floor plan (could be an issue if there are many people inside)#DalOT #studentproject

tags.name: Marquee Ballroom
tags.wheelchair:description: Business entrance contains multiple steps > 7 cm high. Washroom entrance is 83 cm wide. Washroom does not contain handrails, accessible washbasin, or space to maneuver wheelchair. #DalOT #StudentProject

tags.name: Dollarama
tags.wheelchair:description: #DalOT #StudentProject Wheelchair accessible but with no washrooms available for customers.

tags.name: Alex Oh Sushi Rolls
tags.wheelchair:description: 7 Steps up to entrance.

tags.name: Soled Out Sneakers
tags.wheelchair:description: One step to get into business, but it is 8cm high. As you enter the front door, you are led to more steps to get into main business.

tags.name: Suzuki Japanese Restaurant
tags.wheelchair:description: Ramp leading into restaurant and a wide enough door to get in. However, you cannot access dining area due to physical barriers. Washroom was accessible however large dehumidifier was stored in room making it unaccessible.

tags.name: Efendy Turkish & Mediterranean Grill
tags.wheelchair:description: Ramp to outdoor dining area but only way to access inside of restaurant is through stairs.

tags.name: Pino's Hair Studio
tags.wheelchair:description: Business on second floor. Stair access only.

tags.name: Cha Baa Thai
tags.wheelchair:description: Wheelchair accessible entrance located on Queen Street. There’s a wheelchair lift inside which goes up to dining area. Tables weren’t close together. Washroom located downstairs where lift didn’t go. Second exit located on Birmingham Street with stairs.

tags.name: Zwicker's Gallery
tags.wheelchair:description: Multiple steps to get into building and up to main floor/upstairs once inside. Washroom is located on second floor and up a long narrow staircase. Washroom door opens inward. Not enough space for a wheelchair. #DalOT #studentproject

tags.name: Pita Pit
tags.wheelchair:description: An accessible washroom is available but the pathway to get there is narrow in some areas.

tags.name: Woozles Children's Bookstore
tags.wheelchair:description: Ramp to entrance & portable ramp inside to toy area! Ask for ramp as it is set aside. Front door approx 85 cm. Main areas are a bit tight but still possible to move around. Washroom inaccessible, through several small doorways. #DalOT #studentproject

tags.name: Mashawee Mediterranean Grill
tags.wheelchair:description: Access through a ramp on right side of plaza. No automatic door into the restaurant. Bathroom for customers is key access in main building, but the door is too narrow and therefore not accessible.

tags.name: SEG Consulting
tags.source: HRM open Data Halifax Regional Municipality

tags.name: 6123 - Barrington St Before Spring Garden Rd
tags.source: HRM open Data Halifax Regional Municipality;survey

tags.name: SILK
tags.wheelchair:description: Paid parking nearby, sidewalks are accessible and level, and also in good condition. There is also construction directly across the street, which is creating a noisy environment. #DalOT #Studentproject

tags.name: Wax On
tags.wheelchair:description: No automatic door opener but door can stay open. Wide but beds cannot adjust to go lower. Washroom accessible.

tags.name: DeSerres
tags.wheelchair:description: No automatic door. Door opens oddly (outward), which may make it hard to get in. 77cm entrance width. Some obstacles in aisles making them too narrow for a wheelchair to maneuver around. #DalOT #StudentProject

tags.name: Maritime Centre
tags.wheelchair:description: Accessible entrance around the Salter Street side of the building. In the bathroom, there is no handle bar, and the bathroom itself is awkward to enter. #DalOT #StudentProject

tags.disused:name: 2 Doors Down
tags.wheelchair:description: There are two steps to get into the building before getting to the restaurant, making the entrance inaccessible for a wheelchair user. #DalOT #StudentProject

tags.name: Vogue Optical
tags.wheelchair:description: There is less of a slope to entrance when entering from Blowers street. Some aisles in the store are too narrow for a wheelchair to maneuver. #DalOT #StudentProject

tags.name: Downtown Buissness Commission Halifax
tags.wheelchair:description: Ramp maze to get in. Entrance to ramp far from door (near the green box in the photo). #DalOT #StudentProject

tags.name: Cabin Coffee
tags.wheelchair:description: Enough room for individual and their wheelchair. Servers are more than happy to help in anyway that they can.

tags.name: Great Wall Restaurant
tags.wheelchair:description: The width of the entrance door is not wide enough for wheelchair and there were no handrails in the washroom stall.

tags.name: Stayner's Wharf
tags.wheelchair:description: Main entrance has step, but side entrances open. Chairs+tables close together Front doors wide, but no button activation. Door into washrooms 79cm wide. Manager was friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable on wheelchair accommodations

tags.name: Snaxx
tags.wheelchair:description: Step at entrance too high, front door too narrow

tags.name: Impark
tags.wheelchair:description: Numerous steps to enter and exit garage

tags.name: Scotiabank Studio
tags.wheelchair:description: Large ramp from front door to main area of building #DalOT #StudentProject

tags.name: Brigadoon Children's Camp Society Office
tags.source: HRM open Data Halifax Regional Municipality
tags.wheelchair:description: Step >7cm at entrance of building#DalOT #studentproject

tags.name: Monster Comic Lounge
tags.source: HRM open Data Halifax Regional Municipality
tags.wheelchair:description: Crowded floor layout#DalOT #studentproject

tags.name: Independent Mercantile Company
tags.source: HRM open Data Halifax Regional Municipality
tags.wheelchair:description: Sells furniture, home furnishings and decor. Washroom is small, no grab bars around toilet, cupboard beneath sink. Crowded floor plan that may be difficult to maneuver#DalOT #studentproject

tags.name: Addiction Prevention Services
tags.wheelchair:description: the width of the entrance was 85.1 cm, Depending on the how wide the chair is they may be able to enter. #DalOT

tags.name: Prostate Cancer Society NS
tags.wheelchair:description: The entrance was quite narrow and the door was heavy. #DalOT

tags.name: Panacea Body Wellness Centre
tags.wheelchair:description: Automatic doors inside the building and business. Accessible bathroom with grab bar and lowered toilet.

tags.name: Cora
tags.wheelchair:description: Access from Artillery Place, with automatic doors, or through Pete's Fine Foods. Washrooms are not wheelchair accessible. Accessible stall, with grab bar.

tags.name: Pete's Fine Foods
tags.wheelchair:description: Automatic door entrance. Washroom in building labeled accessible, however, entry door is not wide enough, only 88cm. Smaller wheelchairs/walkers would be able to gain access. Accessible stall with grab bar.

tags.name: LDM: Lisa Drader-Murphy
tags.wheelchair:description: The entrance has a step of 4.5" (11.43cm) to enter the store. If able to access the store, there are clothes and change rooms on the main level. The change rooms have a narrow entrance way (less than 36" wide) #DalOT

tags.name: Colwell's
tags.wheelchair:description: Store has attentive staff with large changing rooms close to entrance. Some aisles are narrow, not leaving much room to turn around. There is an accessible washroom in Historic Properties, but no washrooms for public use within Colwell's #DalOT

tags.name: Shanti
tags.wheelchair:description: Wheelchair accessible door located on Birmingham Street

tags.name: Carrefour Atlantic Emporium
tags.wheelchair:description: The door to enter is wide enough but once inside the store the aisles are very narrow filled with delicate giftware. Would not be able to turn around in store. Not accessible beyond doorway #DalOT

tags.name: The Puffin Gallery
tags.wheelchair:description: Slight incline to enter the shop. The counter to pay is low (small table). There would be room to loop all the way around the store, but not turn around inside. Accessible bathroom in Historic Properties #DalOT

tags.name: Bounty Fashion
tags.wheelchair:description: The entrance is very wide. There are racks near the entrance but are on wheels, so moveable as needed. Have large change rooms with curtains. Staff very helpful. #DalOT

tags.name: Toxic Blossom
tags.wheelchair:description: Counter is high. Some aisles are a little narrow but would be able to loop around the store. The change rooms have shag carpets but seem to be rug (removable) #DalOT

tags.name: Lighthouse Gallery
tags.wheelchair:description: Gallery of artwork, may be a pop-up shop. Small shop, entrance is accessible and floor space is L-shaped, so could reverse. Counter is accessible. Shop was closed when photo taken, door normally open. Accessible bathroom in Historic Properties #DalOT

tags.name: Saint Lou's Gentlemen's Barbershop
tags.wheelchair:description: Upon entering there is a lot of open space and staff are very helpful. Can move the current barber chairs out of the way, so client's can stay in their chairs during service. Accessible washroom across hall #DalOT

Cafe in open space, in common walking area of Historic Properties. Counter slightly above 39", but signage is very high and legible. Staff very helpful and can help transport beverages to seating area close by. For washroom, require code from staff #DalOT

tags.name: Cool As A Moose
tags.wheelchair:description: Store can be entered and guests can move around certain areas. Changing room is large but space outside of the door, to enter the change room, is very tight. Counter and displays are at accessible height. Staff very attentive. #DalOT

tags.name: Halifax City Hall
tags.wheelchair:description: Toilet height is appropriate (18 inches) Elevators are newly renovated to be larger. Allocated space in council chambers for those with wheelchairs. All doors wide enough to clear.

tags.name: World Trade Convention Centre
tags.wheelchair:description: There is a ramp up to the main entrance, though it has a tight turn. All doors are an accommodating size (34 - 35 inches) Elevators and ramps are available inside. Washroom is wide, has grab rails, and toilet is an appropriate height (17.5 inches)

tags.name: Take It Outside
tags.wheelchair:description: Only first level of store is accessible (second level requires climbing two flights of stairs). Lots of space to move on lower floor, space available for turning wheelchair. Small changing rooms but curtain doors make rooms easier for access #DalOT

tags.name: The Lower Deck
tags.wheelchair:description: Only wheelchair accessible entrance is on far side of Historic Properties. Could access the main level, but space is very crowded, little room for maneuvering or feeling comfortable at the tables available. Steps up to washroom (not accessible) #DalOT

tags.description: 24hr access; 20CAD weekday, 5CAD weekend and holiday maximims
tags.name: Park Lane Parkade
tags.wheelchair:description: 2 accessible parking spaces on each parkade floor located close to the door with ample room for van off-loading. Parking-payment machine (2nd floor) is high and not totally accessible. P1 is not accessible (stairs). Elevator access to all mall levels.

tags.name: El Este Tacqueria
tags.wheelchair:description: Entrance is accessible, however, it consists of two sets of double doors one after the other. There is a gap of roughly 5 feet between them and no automated button to open the door. Could present some difficulties if entering alone. #DalOT #StudentProject

tags.name: L.A Smith's Convenience Store
tags.wheelchair:description: Totally inaccessible. #DalOT #StudentProject

tags.name: Argyle Fine Art
tags.wheelchair:description: “Partially accessible” because there is a step at the entrance (height = 10 cm), but the store have a wheelchair ramp (width=74cm). One can get an access to the ramp by knocking the window and asking for a help.

tags.name: Barrios Kitchen & Bar
tags.wheelchair:description: Not accessible b/c there is one step at the door entrance about 17cm. toilet is downstairs.

tags.name: The Loop
tags.wheelchair:description: No automatic door and no washroom. The store keeps only one door operating, but the other one is always closed. The measurement of one door = 89 cm

tags.name: The Middle Spoon Desserterie & Bar
tags.wheelchair:description: The middle spoon desserterie & Bar was closed during assessment.

tags.name: The Roy Sales Centre and Decor Model
tags.wheelchair:description: The only reasonably accessible bathroom was located on the second floor in the hair salon. The toilet meets all of the requirements of accessibility with the exception of the door frame, which measures 84 cm. #DalOT #StudentProject

tags.name: Stillwell
tags.wheelchair:description: Downward steps at entrance into basement-style bar. Not at all accessible. #DalOT #StudentProject

tags.name: Elle's Bistro
tags.wheelchair:description: Immediately before the washroom there is a divide in a wall that creates a fairly narrow gap to travel through. There are also tables and chairs on either side of the gap, so during a busy day it may be difficult to traverse. #DalOT #StudentProject

tags.name: Dalhousie Faculty of Architecture and Planning
tags.wheelchair:description: Most rooms fully accessible, fully accessible public events
automatic door

tags.name: Freak Lunchbox
tags.wheelchair:description: front door 37 inches, narrowest area 27 inches and some items high to reach but friendly staff will assist. Can be difficult if it’s busy in store with lots of kids crowding the aisles.

tags.fixme: Due to the homepage it should be locate at 1668
tags.name: Brave New World
tags.wheelchair:description: elevator

tags.name: The Auction House
tags.wheelchair:description:
No automatic door opening button, two doors very close together that swing outwards.
4-6 Steps to every dining area except for the bar.
The bar is high.
Bathroom is narrow and not accessible without ascending the stairs.

tags.name: Halifax Cycling Coalition Discount
tags.note: Show your Halifax Cycling Coalition card and receive MEC: 10% Off Bike Shop Services & purchase at MEC Club Nights! Become a member at https://cyclehalifax.ca/register/

tags.name: Cineplex Cinemas Park Lane
tags.wheelchair:description: Ramp entrance to the building, with wide front doors. Elevators inside the mall and movie theatre to access the multiple floors. #DalOT

tags.name: The BG
tags.wheelchair:description: Accessible through the front with limited seating however; ramp in the back provides access to another level of seating. Wheelchair accessible bathroom behind the building. #DalOT # StudentProject

tags.name: Buck Ugly‘s
tags.wheelchair:description: Main entrance wheel chair accessible, although ramp is steep Bathrooms do not have handrails and no automatic door openers #DalOT

tags.name: HFX sports bar and grill
tags.wheelchair:description: Bar area has many pub style tables, but has booth that are wheelchair height #DalOT

tags.name: Giant
tags.wheelchair:description: To access the main entrance, you would go onto the shop level at Sackville street and then wheel around the corner to the main entrance. The product layout in the shop is spaced out and very maneuverable.

tags.name: Fit4Less
tags.wheelchair:description: Elevator access from ground floor by Pete's. Narrow hallway towards gym. Change rooms not accessible, tight space between lockers and change rooms. Assistance required to open bathroom door #DalOT #StudentProject

tags.name: Sun City Tanning Studio
tags.wheelchair:description: The only way to access Sun City Tanning Studio is by going up a set of 6 stairs to the main entrance of the building it is in, and then ascending a narrow flight of stairs to the second floor, where it is.

tags.name: Barrington Gate Apartments
tags.wheelchair:description: Ramp to the front door allows for accessibility. Both the elevator and unit doors were larger then 35". The bathrooms were also big enough to maneuver a wheelchair. #DalOT

tags.name: Four Points by Sheraton Halifax
tags.wheelchair:description: Hotel has wheelchair accessible entrance with sensor automatic door and wheelchair accessible washrooms in lobby. Hotel also has wheelchair accessible rooms #DalOT #StudentProject

tags.name: Residence Inn Halifax Downtown
tags.wheelchair:description: Accessible entrance way with slight slope and accessible bathrooms on the main level. #DalOT #StudentProject

tags.name: ICT Northumberland College
tags.source: HRM open Data Halifax Regional Municipality

tags.name: LF Bakery
tags.wheelchair:description: Doorway to bakery > 90 cm. No steps or doorway lip to manuever over. Washroom doorway is 90 cm. Washroom contains handrails by toilet and wheelchair-accessible hand basin. #DalOT #StudentProject

tags.name: The Keg
tags.wheelchair:description: Restaurant has accessible entrance and bathrooms that are spacious and have hand grips. There are many tables which are wheelchair accessible however certain areas of the restaurant have two to three steps leading up to tables. #DalOT #StudentProject

tags.name: Baton Rouge
tags.wheelchair:description: #DalOT #StudentProject

tags.name: Summit Cafe
tags.wheelchair:description: #DalOT #studentproject

tags.name: The Foggy Goggle
tags.wheelchair:description: Doorway to pub > 90 cm. Ramp to get in is at a high grade. Washroom doorway is >90 cm. Washroom contains handrails by toilet and wheelchair-accessible hand basin. #DalOT #StudentProject

tags.name: 2 Crows Brewing
tags.wheelchair:description: Entrance is accessible >90cm with ramp inside. Low tables and section of bar but the rest of the physical bar is at stool height. Outside patio is partially accessible. Accessible single stall washroom. #DalOT #studentproject

tags.name: Murphy's The Cable Wharf
tags.wheelchair:description: Entrance: 7cm step, and door inner-width is 92cm. Bathroom stall: 80cm door inner-width and 122x147cm of clear space. No opportunity to maneuver wheelchairs under counters to reach tap. Soap/paper towel dispensers are accessible. #DalOT #StudentProject

tags.name: Insight Optometry
tags.source: HRM open Data Halifax Regional Municipality
tags.wheelchair:description: Fully accessible. Easy access to the building with machine operated doors. Wide hallway leading to the washroom. Handles around toilet and space for wheelchair to fit under the sink. #DalOT #StudentProject
